Use aged sandstone, cracked paving, rubble, and moss; decorate the tree with chains and offerings, lit by amber and turquoise glows.

Create a dense ruined Greco-Roman sanctuary enclosing a sunken courtyard with a massive twisted dead tree. Surround it with roofless colonnades, monumental temples, stairs, and raised passages. Use aged sandstone, cracked paving, rubble, and moss; decorate the tree with chains and offerings, lit by amber and turquoise glows.

    === GROUND ===
    Build the FLOOR FIRST, before placing anything else. Call the benchmark
    tool `ground_pass` as your first build action: it carpets the whole 200 m
    plate deterministically from a tile chosen for this scene. If you skip it,
    and do not tile a floor yourself, the scene renders as objects floating
    over empty space -- which is a failed reconstruction no matter how good
    the massing is. These palette entries are also flat surfaces you can tile
    by hand if you prefer:
